crossRefs.note: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

translations.web: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.
translations.bsb: The king replied, “I know for sure that you are stalling for time because you see that my word is final.
translations.kjv: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from
